usedFor: Assembla is where tickets are filed and Asana is where work is planned, via “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Assembla, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each ticket becomes a task, and the action can set assignee, tags, dates and description.

watchOut: “New Ticket Change” fires on any edit to a ticket, so it can create several tasks for one ticket.
